name: elemental-fire-emberfall
brief: Fire elemental boss battle theme, 150 BPM in D Phrygian. Driving taiko and frame-drum percussion with galloping triplets, aggressive staccato string ostinato in the low register, low brass swells and braams answering the strings, a cracking rhythmic fire-crackle texture layer, and a shredding modal melody on horns. Phrased as a fight through seven sections: tension intro, burning theme, development, molten peak, brief smoldering breakdown, full blaze reprise, and a loop-safe outro whose last bar resolves back into the intro tension bed. Seamless game loop, no fade-out, high energy throughout, cinematic hybrid orchestral.

_loop_and_duration_basis: 150 BPM, 4/4 -> one bar = 4*60/150 = 1.600 s exactly. 75 bars = 120.0 s (master loop). 16 bars = 25.6 s and 32 bars = 51.2 s are the in-engine short loops. The loop-10min video is 600.0 s = exactly 5 x 120.0 s, which is why 120.0 s is the chosen master length (a 51.2 s loop would need 11.719 tiles and a 102.4 s loop 5.859 - both leave a broken final seam). 120 s is inside the planner guard rail (planner.py MIN_DURATION_S=30, MAX_DURATION_S=420); 600 s is NOT, which is why the 10-minute artifact is a video, never a single render.

_rights: INSTRUMENTAL -> no human-authored lyrics -> an AI-Generated Output under SOCAN's guidelines, not an AI-Assisted Work. No PRO registration and no publishing-royalty path for this genre; a US Copyright Office registration would have to disclaim the whole composition. Not a blocker for game-assets (licence sale) or youtube-gaming (ad revenue). Source: music/docs/pro-registration.md sections 1 and 3.
_isrc: No ISRC is proposed here. An ISRC has NO check digit (IFPI International ISRC Agency Bulletin 2015/01 rev 3, ISO 3901:2019) - 12 characters, 2 letters + 3 alphanumeric + 2 digits + 5 digits. music/gates/gate_release_ready.py:92 isrc_syntax() implements exactly that and is correct; its docstring lines 13-15 wrongly claim a check digit. Do not fabricate a 13-character code.
